subject: South Street Local Historic District
overview: The Medford Historic District Commission met to plan its primary project for the fiscal year centered on creating a South Street local historic district. The commission voted to establish a subcommittee to explore the proposal and discussed funding a consultant to guide the designation process.

items.title: South Street Local Historic District Proposal
items.summary: The commission discussed establishing a South Street local historic district and voted to create a subcommittee to oversee the initiative.

items.title: Consultant Funding and Outreach Planning
items.summary: Members discussed allocating commission funds for a consultant to define district boundaries and prepare guidelines, while planning public engagement and a meeting with the mayor.

items.title: Public Comment
items.summary: Resident Maryanne Adduci shared information regarding the historic Middlesex Canal route along West Street and offered to fund a historical marker.
